scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run compile && node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/hosttest.py --label unit
scripts.test:watch: npm run compile && concurrently -k "tsc -w -p ./tsconfig.extension.json" "node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/esbuild.py --watch" "node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/hosttest.py --label unit --watch --watch-files dist/extension/bin/client"
scripts.test:host: npm run compile && node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/hosttest.py --label host
scripts.test:smoke: npm run compile && node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/hosttest.py --label smoke --label live
scripts.test:rules-sync: npm run compile && node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/hosttest.py --label rules-sync
scripts.test:native: npm run compile && node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/hosttest.py --native
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/host_coverage.py && node scripts/build/python.mjs scripts/build/coverage_summary.py --host-only
